name: Inami Shuu
source: He's a student who commutes to school. He uses the first person pronoun ¨Boku¨, he takes after his mother, being a bit of a babyface and a shota. He was Renge's boyfriend, however he doesn't have any kids yet. Having been told to have children, at last he will try to do it…….
